events.region: Tinian Coastal Waters; Saipan Coastal Waters
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 7 to 11 feet.

* WHERE...Tinian and Saipan Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM ChST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Moderate to strong westerlies prevail
across the Marianas as another resurgence in the monsoon builds
over the northern CNMI, likely to maintain moderate to strong
winds the next several days. Occasional gusts to 35 kt are
possible near heavier showers, mainly across northern Saipan
waters. Combined seas of 7 to 11 feet are expected to continue
through much of the coming week, remaining hazardous to small
craft through at least Thursday afternoon as the southern edge
of the monsoon surge persists overhead.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Cook County in northeastern Illinois...
Central DuPage County in northeastern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 430 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Flooding
may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Underpasses may be
flooded. Roads and streets may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 126 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Radar and observations indicate these storms are
producing a quick 1 to 2 inches of rain in less than 45 minutes.
This will likely result in minor flooding shortly after
thunderstorms arrive.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Chicago, Cicero, Evanston, Skokie, Berwyn, Wheaton, Oak Park,
Downers Grove, Elmhurst, Lombard, Ohare Airport, Carol Stream,
Park Ridge, Addison, Glendale Heights and Niles.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Coastal waters from Port Fourchon Louisiana to Lower Atchafalaya
River LA from 20 to 60 NM...

At 128 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots and weak waterspouts. This
thunderstorm was located 23 nm east of Ship Shoal 198, or 27 nm south
of Isle Derniers, moving northwest at 10 knots.

Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves and dangerous lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe
harbor immediately until this activity passes.

Brief, weak waterspouts are possible with this activity. Remain on
alert in case warnings are issued for waterspout development.
